title: Owned MC: which table fails the function test?
stem_student: Which table of values does NOT represent a function of x? A) x: −2, −1, 0, 1  |  y: 4, 1, 0, 1   B) x: 1, 2, 3, 2  |  y: 5, 7, 9, 11   C) x: −1, 0, 1, 2  |  y: 2, 2, 2, 2   D) x: 0, 1, 2, 3  |  y: 0, 1, 4, 9
stem_teacher: LLOVES-owned MC. B repeats an x-input with two different y-outputs, so it is not a function. Aligns to A2.1 table representation; not Ministry wording.
answer_verification: In B the input x = 2 appears twice with y = 7 and y = 11.
